title: EU MIR 7.3.1 rule book (88 blocks, five report types)
plain: The blocks the EU MIR requires in each report type (Initial, Follow up, Combined initial and final, Final (Reportable incident), Final (Non-reportable incident)), as a CSV rule book from the mapping workbook's EU sheet: mandatory, conditional or optional, with the XML path and the MDARIX fields that hold each block. Where the help text and the XSD disagree, the stricter of the two (B8-D6).

change.reason: B8 step 2: the EU MIR rules held as data from the start; the form's own must_in (forms.py) is checked against it.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.
